newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots rating cut.

text.p: Everen Securities Inc analyst Kevin Silverman said Wednesday he reduced his intermediate rating on retailer Talbots Inc to market perform from outperform.

-- He also cut his earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 ending in January 1998 to $1.41 a share from $2.04. He also cut estimates for fiscal 1998 to $2.25 from $2.39 and for fiscal 1999 to $2.50 from $2.80.
-- This followed Talbot's announcement late Tuesday that it expected to report a loss for the fiscal second quarter of $0.28 to $0.38 a share due to weak sales.
-- The analyst also cut the six-month price target for the stock to $27 a share from $36.
-- Shares at mid-day Wednesday were down 5-3/4 at 23-1/4.
-- The analyst said the long-term rating remains outperform, but the 18-month price target for the stock was cut to $38 a share from $42.
